content_text: I didn’t listen to this podcast, but don’t you think he just meant that he had to up the ISO in order to get to a t8 or t11? Depending on how close you are focusing that still will render things in the far background out of focus, just not a complete blur. Other aspects like distortion, flares and the shape of the bokeh will also stay typical anamorphic.
